Class TestYourController

java.lang.Object
reversi.SimpleModel
reversi.TestYourController
All Implemented Interfaces:
reversi.IModel, reversi.IView
public class TestYourController extends reversi.SimpleModel implements reversi.IView
This is a very simple controller just to give you a graphical option, and illustrate how things like buttons would work on the graphics interface.
